brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to predict term-deposit subscription: the two-level outcome column y (no/yes) is the target, making this binary classification. Call duration is known only after the call concludes and strongly encodes the outcome, so it is flagged as leakage rather than a feature; day/month are campaign calendar attributes, not a consecutive series of one unit, so no grouping or time columns are declared.
brief.repeated_subjects: Same client may be contacted multiple times across campaigns, but no client identifier is present to link records.
brief.unit: one outbound marketing contact (client call record)
